features: Rugged, Anti-Slip Body: Designed for everyday comfort and durability, the Apex PB445 features a rugged anti-slip body with a premium soft-touch finish that offers a secure grip and a refined in-hand feel, reducing accidental slips during daily use.

20000mAh High-Capacity Battery: Stay powered throughout your day with the 20000mAh high-capacity Li-ion polymer battery, engineered with smart power management for reliable and efficient charging. Whether you're travelling, working, or commuting, enjoy dependable backup power for your everyday devices.

45W 2-Way Turbo Fast Charging: Experience ultra-fast charging with 45W Turbo Fast Charging, designed to quickly power compatible devices while rapidly recharging the power bank itself. Supporting QC 3.0, Power Delivery (PD), and PPS fast-charging protocols, it helps minimise charging downtime and keeps you ready for whatever comes next.

22.5W USB-A Fast Charging: The dedicated USB-A output supports up to 22.5W fast charging, allowing you to quickly charge a wide range of compatible smartphones, accessories, and other USB-powered devices with stable and efficient power delivery.

Built-in 2-Way Type-C Charging Cable: The integrated 2-Way Type-C charging cable lets you charge your devices and recharge the power bank without carrying an additional cable. Designed for convenience, it offers a clutter-free charging experience whether you're at home, in the office, or on the move.
